walkthrough: Goal: Drawabox's form intersections (穿插): the line along which one form passes into another, its pierce points first, then the line between them, which fixes how the two stand in space. The app lays the exact line over my drawing and my eye judges it (D123).

Entry: unit 8's tile Form intersections (after Contours, before Contrast thumbnails), or Start when it is next; no pack is needed. A lesson holds two pairs, about 3 minutes each. Level 1: a box into a box, across one of its edges or round one of its corners, both drawn through; level 2: a cylinder through a box's face, or a box into a cylinder's side, both drawn through; level 3: two cylinders, the thinner entering the thicker's side, or a ball sunk into a cylinder's side, only what I see of them printed.

How, first time: Where two forms meet; finding the line where one form passes into another: the pierce points first, then the line between them. The example plays in its one frame, a box across another's edge, both drawn through: 1 each edge carried into the other's face towards its vanishing point; 2 where an edge meets a face, the pierce points dotted; 3 the points joined along the faces in ink, the first piece a little off; 4 Compare: the line red, its hidden stretch dashed red. One paragraph says to find the pierce points first in each face's own perspective and join them along the faces, and to draw both forms through. Got it.

The exercise: one frame holds the horizon (labelled) and two boxes printed grey in one perspective, drawn through: what I see whole, what is hidden or inside the other dashed and thinner. The second box sits on the first one's far top corner, part of it inside. The tools: Sketch, Draw, Undo, Redo; Compare once something is drawn.
With Draw I draw the line where they meet on the near faces, an L down the main box's side, but its upright a little to the right (a mistake).

Compare: the exact line in see-through red over my ink, its stretch behind the forms dashed red; my upright stands beside the red. The card: Form intersections 1, Construction, How close is it?, Accurate, Almost, Again; no reason, nothing ringed, no number. The pen is blue (Correct). Construction lays each edge carried across the other's faces dashed in pencil and rings every pierce point; tapped again, it goes.

I redraw the upright on the red in blue and Compare again; I choose Almost, kept with the exercise once. Next: the second pair, the other way round a box; I draw its line, Compare, Accurate. Finish: the lesson's end, Form intersections, 2 exercises, their results.
Reopen: Home leaves a lesson under way; Continue on the home reopens it as it was.

Level 2's first lesson opens on its own How (S158k): A cylinder and a box; on the box's face, the cylinder's circle drawn as the ellipse in its square. The example, a cylinder through a box's face, both drawn through: 1 on the face the square the cylinder sits in, in the face's perspective, and its diagonals; 2 through their crossing the lines to the middles of its sides, the four middles dotted; 3 the ellipse through them in ink, the first piece a little off; 4 Compare: the ellipse red, its hidden half dashed. One paragraph: the circle lies in the face, the ellipse touches each side at its middle; a box into a cylinder's side cuts it in lines along it and arcs across it; both forms drawn through. Got it.

Level 3's first lesson opens on its own How: Two round forms; sections cut across both, the points where their lines cross. The example, a thin cylinder into a thick one's side, only what the eye sees printed: 1 with Sketch a few sections across both forms, the thin one's sides carried to the thick one's surface and its lines along its length; 2 where each section's lines cross, a point of the line dotted; 3 the points joined in ink; 4 Compare. One paragraph: sections along the forms' own directions; a ball sunk into a cylinder cut across the cylinder, two circles a section crossing on the line. Got it.

Level 2 (熟练): a cylinder through a box's face (its circle on the face, an ellipse in the face's square, which Construction lays with its diagonals and middles), or a box into a cylinder's side (lines along it, arcs of its sections, the sections laid as ellipses). Level 3 (稳): a thin cylinder into a thick one's side, or a ball sunk into a cylinder's side: only what I see printed; Construction lays a few sections across both forms and dots where their lines cross. I choose Again; Finish; That's all for today. All units, Unit 8: Contours, Form intersections, Contrast thumbnails.
